root_cause: The get_document function returns document content without verifying that requesting_user_id matches the document owner_id.
explanation: Check that doc['owner_id'] equals requesting_user_id before returning, raising a PermissionError on ownership mismatch.
patch_text:
diff --git a/app/access.py b/app/access.py
--- a/app/access.py
+++ b/app/access.py
@@ -76,4 +76,6 @@
 
     # VULNERABLE IMPLEMENTATION (Broken Object-Level Authorization):
     # Fails to enforce that doc["owner_id"] == requesting_user_id before returning.
+    if doc["owner_id"] != requesting_user_id:
+        raise PermissionError("Access denied: requesting user does not own this document")
     return dict(doc)
